tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: List or search newly noticed startups. Filter by name/website text, sector, and when Scout found them (today, 3 days, 7 days, all); sort by newest or by 7-day follower growth. Returns up to 100 companies per call plus nextCursor for the next page. Use this first for any "find/list new startups" ques

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get one company's full Scout profile by its X handle: bio, website and its description, followers and 7-day growth, latest X post, and latest funding round. Use when you already know the handle; returns an error result if Scout has not listed it.

tools.name: get_discovery_stats
tools.description: Count how many companies Scout found on each of the last 7 days, and the total listed, optionally within one sector. Use for trend questions such as "how many new AI startups this week"; it returns numbers, not companies.

tools.name: list_sectors
tools.description: Return the sector slugs and display names that the sector filter of search_companies and get_discovery_stats accepts. Call it only when you need to map a user's wording to a slug.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company · Public sink: get_company.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company · Public sink: get_company

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
